title: Corpus manifest
description: The input of CorpusProcess.wit and CorpusPreflight.wit: the pipeline contract, the origins the nodes may fetch from, and the shards. Unknown keys are errors.

version.description: The lab's name for the contract; travels into every product.

language_model_sha256.description: Pin of the language model blob's bytes; the job does not start when the blob differs. A language pack (WITLID2) carries its languages' rule data and acceptance limits, so the pin covers them: a document in a language the pack does not support drops as language_unsupported, one with too little text as language_unknown. A WITLID1 model gives the products it gave under Corpus 0.1.x.

target_languages.description: ISO 639-3 codes to keep (languages the model supports); empty keeps every identified language. Another supported language drops as language_not_target.

clean_lines.description: Whether the lines that do not read like prose (menus, prices, footers) leave each document before it is judged.

sign.description: Whether a MinHash signature is produced per document.

filter_curly_bracket.description: C4's curly-bracket rule (Raffel et al. 2020; DataTrove's filter_curly_bracket): a document goes, as curly_bracket, when a line C4 would test holds '{' - a line without a word over 1,000 characters, with the shape of prose, that does not mention JavaScript. Catches code and template leftovers; off by default.

quality.description: Thresholds of the Gopher-style rules; a key left out (or 0) is the stage default.

allowed_origins.description: Host names (a URL or host:port is reduced to its host); matched exactly, case-insensitively. The list narrows what a machine fetches from and cannot widen it: beyond the public origins compiled into the controller (data.commoncrawl.org), a machine fetches only from hosts its owner listed in OMNIBUSCLOUD_CORPUS_ORIGINS and answers OriginRefused for the rest.

oneOf.description: A shard URL whose extension tells the format: .warc.wet.gz is WET, .warc.gz is WARC.

size.description: Estimated bytes on the wire: the traffic line and the cap check.

sha256.description: The origin's published hash; the node verifies the fetched bytes against it.
